# LSR-2 inspection sheet (generated by `cad/lsr2/tolerances.py`)

One sheet per finished body, lid, mast bracket, yoke arm pair, saddle and shaft. Fill the **Result** column on the first article and on every batch; the reason for each tolerance is in [LSR2_TOLERANCES](LSR2_TOLERANCES.md). Rev A0. Serial: ______  Date: ______  Inspector: ______  Casting heat / bar lot: ______
